scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The exact threshold is proved for the stated point-supported derivative family and general distributional phi-transform.
No claim is made for all distributions or for each specific Fourier-inversion summability method.
The subunit range above \(n/(n+m)\) for a fixed dimension and order is unresolved here.
The construction refines a known pointwise obstruction; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact subunit-\(L^p\) thresholds for point-supported \(\phi\)-transform obstructions
